notes: São Luís is a bus-only city (no metro/rail/BRT/ferry), so the metro-first directive does not apply; route_type is 3 for all. Operator scope: Consórcio Central = Lote I of the SIT (Sistema Integrado de Transporte), operated by Taguatur + RATRANS, covering the Itaqui-Bacanga margin and Centro, feeding Terminal Praia Grande (SETSL/Wikipedia). SOURCES USED: Moovit per-line route PDFs (appassets.mvtdev.com/map/131/l/4043/{lineID}.pdf) gave FULL ordered stop sequences + exact published operating hours/days per line — this is the primary, high-quality data. I probed the São Luís Moovit line-ID block (195456330–195456375) and retrieved 46 line PDFs for the whole city, then selected 6 clearly-evidenced Consórcio Central / Terminal Praia Grande / Itaqui-Bacanga corridor lines with complete stop lists: T302 ITAQUI, A311 CAMPUS UFMA, A313 TAMANCÃO, A321 SÁ VIANA, A401 PENÍNSULA, T005 PEDRINHAS. Moovit's public HTML (index/line/stop pages) is JS-rendered and returned empty via WebFetch; the mobilibus and setsl.com.br sources had no machine-readable line/stop tables. STOP GEOCODING: ~800 OSM highway=bus_stop nodes in the São Luís bbox (fetched via Overpass mail.ru mirror; 758 nodes, 209 named) served as the WGS-84 coordinate seed. Only ~18 stop names matched OSM nodes reliably by name (fuzzy match ≥0.55 was noisy — many false hits), so exact OSM coordinates were used for the trustworthy transfer hubs (all UFMA campus buildings CCBS/CCET/CCSo/CPPF/Biblioteca/RU, CEPRAMA, UPA/Unidade Mista Itaqui-Bacanga, Mercado Central, Mercado do Peixe, Praça dos Pescadores, Fonte do Bispo, Praça do Anil, Garagem Ratrans). The remaining stops were placed at curated neighborhood/landmark WGS-84 centroids (Porto do Itaqui, Ponta da Madeira, Anjo da Guarda, Vila Bacanga, São Francisco, Ponta D'Areia, Península, Sá Viana, Alto da Esperança, Pedrinhas, BR-135 corridor, Av. Emiliano Macieira industrial zone, etc.). All 139 stops have coordinates; none left null. LIMITATIONS lowering confidence: (1) neighborhood-centroid coordinates are approximate (stops in the same district share a centroid, so per-stop precision is ~street/neighborhood level, not exact); (2) Moovit stop names carry no official A###/T### stop codes (the A/T prefixes are LINE codes, not stop codes — no per-stop codes were published); (3) each route is represented by ONE trip per direction departing at the published service start — headways are not published on Moovit so the single representative trip uses even ~2 min inter-stop spacing over the route's stated duration rather than a real timetable; (4) line-to-operator assignment for Consórcio Central is inferred from the Lote I / Itaqui-Bacanga-Praia Grande service area (SETSL + Wikipedia) since no official numbered per-operator line list was published; the 6 selected lines are strongly consistent with that area but the exact Taguatur-vs-RATRANS split within the consortium is not asserted. Service calendars are faithful to the PDF day tables: T302 & A311 weekday-only; A321 Mon-Sat; A313, A401, T005 daily. Agency timezone America/Fortaleza (Maranhão observes UTC-3, no DST).
